title: Minibeast branching key and sorting cards
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Seeded from science/y4 lesson 27 (Minibeast branching key and sorting cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 27: Grouping living things with keys. To understand how a classification key helps us name and group living things

blocks.title: Sort into: Vertebrate / Invertebrate
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Vertebrate, Invertebrate.
blocks.answer: Vertebrate: Fish; Bird; Frog; Cat. Invertebrate: Snail; Spider; Worm; Beetle

questions.q: Use the key: eight legs, no wings. What is it?
questions.model: Start at the top: does it have legs? Yes. More than six? Yes, eight. Eight legs: spider.

questions.q: Write a yes or no question that splits a snail from a worm.
Use the minibeast key on the portal sheet to name six minibeasts.
questions.a: Snail, slug, worm, woodlouse, spider, ladybird (as on the sheet)
questions.model: Teacher does the first one on screen: 'six legs? yes; spots? yes: ladybird'.

questions.q: Make a key for four creatures you found at home.
questions.a: A working key with yes or no feature questions

questions.q: Why might two scientists in different countries use the same key?
questions.a: So everyone names and groups living things the same way

questions.q: An animal with a backbone is a...
Big question: how could a scientist group a new creature?
questions.a: Look at its features and use a key to sort it.
